import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    
    res = 0
    if s is not None and len(s) > 1:
        i = 0
        while i < len(s):
            j = i + 1
            while j < len(s) and s[j] == s[j - 1]:
                j += 1
            length = j - i
            if length % 2 == 0:
                res += 1
            i = j
    
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
